blocks.text: Health screenings are emerging as another draw for foreign visitors to South Korea, with a growing number choosing the country for medical checkups, data showed Sunday. A total of 65,228 foreign patients underwent health screenings in Korea last year, up 17 percent from a year earlier, according to the Ministry of Health and Welfare. The upward trend appears to be continuing this year.
